scenes.name: follow-the-green-cell
scenes.prompt: Within an impossible opalescent lattice, one faceted emerald crystal cell near the lower right contains a miniature living alien jungle. We drift toward this particular green jewel as the translucent surrounding membranes flex and open. The jewel is edged by intricately carved ivory ribs; tiny lush ferns, curled leaves, coral flowers and luminous green canopies grow inside it. Rose and cyan glass cells and delicate silver webs continue into the background. Extraordinary fractal microarchitecture, thousands of tiny crystalline chambers, rich layered dimensional material. A recognizable miniature world inside a transparent jewel. No people, no lettering, no flat icons.

scenes.name: a-world-in-the-jewel
scenes.prompt: A beautiful large emerald crystal cell cradles a dense miniature alien jungle, the lush green inner world becoming the focal form near the middle. Intricate fern forests, curling vines, tiny coral flowers and deep teal pools are visible through the transparent shell. Around it, pale opalescent ribs and rose glass membranes curl into an elongated seed-like shape. The surrounding crystalline garden folds away to reveal the living world within. The shell is finely faceted and translucent, detailed silver and ivory filaments wrap around the green interior, jewel-like organic sculpture, astonishing microscopic detail and spatial depth. No people, no text, no diagram.

motion_note.intent: The actual lower-right emerald cell contains a small forest. Move it toward center and reveal the living interior as the surrounding membrane gently flexes. A single broad development, without an oscillating camera cycle.
